Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Note 1 —The dimension x shall be according to IS : 1369-1975 ' Dimensions of screw thread run-outs 
and undercuts ( first revision ) \ 

Note 2 — The dimension z shall be according to IS: 1368-1967 * Dimensions of ends of bolts and screws 
( first revision ) '• 

Note 3 — The bigger head diameter (tf, ) values given in brackets are applicable for springs in which the 
leaves have a round radius of up to 2 mm; this shall be mutually agreed upon between the purchaser and the 
supplier at the time of order- 

Note 4 — Other head heights (A), if used, shall be specifically indicated in the designation. 

Note 5 — Hexagon nuts shall be according to IS : 1364-1967 ' Specification for precision and semi-precision 
hexagon bolts, screws, nuts and lock nuts (diameter range 6 to 39 mm ) ( first revision ) '. 

Note 6 — Lock nut shall be according to IS : 7002-1972 ' Mechanical performance requirements of prevailing 
torque type steel hexagon lock nuts \ 

Note 7 — The Size M 16 shall not be used for new designs.

IS: 9484 -1980 

3. Mechanical Properties — Shall conform to property class 8.8 or 9.8 for passenger cars and 
light vehicles and property class 10.9 for heavy vehicles, according to IS: 1367-1967 'Technical 
supply conditions for threaded fasteners ( first revision ) \ 

4. Designation — Shall be designated byname, nominal size, length, number of this standard and 
the property class. 

Example: 

A centre bolt with round shank with thread </i = M8, length / 80 mm and property 
class 8.8 shall be designated as: 

Centre Bolt M8 x 80 IS : 9484 8.8 

4.1 Designation of the same bolt, but with head height A = 5 mm: 

Centre Bolt M8 x 80 x 5 IS ; 9484 8.8 

5- Marking — As specified in IS : 1367 ( Part XVIII )-1979 ' Technical supply conditions for threaded 
fasteners: Part XVIII Marking and mode of delivery ( first revision ) ! . 

5.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The centre bolts covered by this standard are intended to be used for leaf spring assemblies 
for automobiles [see IS : 1135-1973 Specification for leaf springs for automobile suspension 
(second revision )] and leaf spring assemblies for railway rolling stock. 

In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been deriveel from DIN 4626-1977 
1 Centre bolts for laminated leaf springs ' issued by Deutsches Institut fur Normung ( DIN ). 



Printed at Arcee Press, New Delhi. India
